recipe.text:
At the café, Ana reads a résumé and orders tea.
Her naïve first sketch becomes a useful design.	The words stay in order, with accents intact; no one needs to type in capitals. A small printed page should leave enough room to read, share, and test the exact link.

summary.sourceWhitespace: Preserved exactly in source TXT and recipe. Display wraps whole words and normalizes inter-word whitespace.
